research_rationale:
EO 9447 (June 8, 1944; 9 FR 6293) is an amendment-only order: it rewrites subsections A1(b), A2(b), A3(b), B1 and B6 of EO 9356 of June 24, 1943 (regulations on clothing in kind or cash allowances for enlisted Navy and Coast Guard personnel), effective July 1, 1944. The held Federal Register original was read in full. Three of the subsections are fiscal-year-1945 rate rows that ended by their own terms on June 30, 1945; the other two (B1 payment timing and B6 credit rule) are continuing rules that lived inside EO 9356 until EO 9744B (signed June 29, 1946; 11 FR 7391) superseded EO 9356, EO 9447 and the other listed amending orders and prescribed fresh regulations for the fiscal year 1947. The Federal Register catalog and the 1989 codification both record the amendment of EO 9356 and the supersession by EO 9744-B. The held later amendments of EO 9356 (EO 9525, EO 9642 and the other orders listed in EO 9744B) do not revive or extend EO 9447. The recommended provisional status is no.

savings.reason: The order's rules governed cash and in-kind clothing allowances for enlisted personnel in fiscal years 1944 to 1946. EO 9744B supersedes EO 9447 by name and replaces its subject matter with new regulations for fiscal year 1947 onward, so no allowance payable under the rewritten subsections was left governed by EO 9447 after the supersession, and no later held instrument saves or revives it. The held sources show no accrued right or liability that the order alone preserves, and the bounded U.S. Code, eCFR and Federal Register catalog searches found no later instrument naming it.
